{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to counteract overconfidence.",
    "Increase forecast lag by 1-2 days if recent history shows persistent underestimation of price spikes.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 5% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 10-15% to avoid overshoot.",
    "When sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.00), slightly increase forecast volatility to reflect bullish momentum.",
    "For high sentiment periods (sentiment > 0.50), reduce forecast bias by 5-10% to avoid overreaction.",
    "If true outcome consistently exceeds forecast by > 3% over 30-day window, shift model toward higher variance in next forecast.",
    "In low volatility regimes (e.g., < 2% daily range), apply smoothing to prevent false spikes in forecast."
  ]
}
